pygt_source.repository_license_claim: LICENSE contains an MIT permission grant and its copyright notice names the Python Packaging Authority; README credits TD Swinburne and D Kannan. This license file does not cover the LJ38 data archive.
pygt_source.loader_interface: load_ktn(path, beta=1.0, Nmax=None, Emax=None, ...); reads min.data/ts.data, converts one-based endpoints to zero-based, computes harmonic unimolecular TST rate weights, sums parallel saddle contributions, and returns a largest-rate-component retained mask; load_ktn_AB maps min.A/min.B through the retained mask

benchmark_interface_and_open_items.loader_call_shape: load_ktn(path, beta=<declared inverse temperature>, Nmax=None, Emax=None)
benchmark_interface_and_open_items.mask_mapping: After the loader returns retained, original IDs are np.flatnonzero(retained)+1 in returned-row order; create one-hot endpoint masks using the positions of IDs 1 and 7. load_ktn_AB yields the broader archive min.A/min.B sets instead.
benchmark_interface_and_open_items.pathdata_temperature_note: PATHSAMPLE control setting; not assumed to define the PyGT beta convention
